Page 38 Cont.
May 25th Jerry Nowiski - 18675 Warrington Drive - 4 - cannot walk or even stand alone or lift his little legs. Enrolled To-day
29 Joseph Brennan - 50 - Eyeritis - badly inflamed eyes ..... Enrolls 5.
Margaret McCarthy - 40 - nerve trouble ... in sanitarium 7 weeks under treatment - $300.00 per week + Dr's
Brooklyn, N.Y. Sept. 14, 1945 - Mrs. Nagle noted above May 25 - 29 here To-day quite Okay. Were it not that her hair is turning gray she could pass for 30. 1946 Here again To-day March 7th - in perfect health.
1945, June
Page 39 June 2nd Charles J. Davitt - 53 - thought to have pneumonia, was given sulpha- drip ... now hiccough since last thursday - whole week ...
W'm McEachen - Sarnia, Ontario - 25 - fractured, both eyes gorged out and unable to see when replaced. .. Enrolled and blessed. That was five yrs. ago. He s a soldier To-day; when they went home from Monastery and took off bandage he screamed "I can see."
Adrien Sciba - 18 - taking spasims for five yrs. seemingly from bad stomach conditions.
Mr. Edw'd Selcke - 63 - intestinal cancer - has quite a family - one daughter Nun of St. Dominic.
Francis Jos. Chauvin - 27 - of Windsor - wounded in Germany - prisoner for two weeks with medical aid; lost one leg - hope to save the other - Enrolled Today - perpetual.
Page 40 June 3 3 Bernard Champine - 55 - fearful eye - ulcer - Enrolled in Ser. Masses special
Howard J. Ryan - 49 - threatened nerves.
Mrs. Anna Walunas - 41 - Very threatening cancerous condition - con- tinual pains - Enrolls perpetually ..... Has had 60 hours of radium treatments . .2 yrs.
James Nash - 35 - serious mental in Battle Creek Veteran Hospital.
